parameters.query:
DECLARE @RequestId NVARCHAR(100) =
    N'{{ String($json.RequestId ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}';

DECLARE @OldRoomKey NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'{{ String($json.OldRoomKey ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}';

DECLARE @NewRoomKey NVARCHAR(MAX) =
    N'{{ String($json.NewRoomKey ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}';


-- Basic validation only. Room keys have no fixed format or length.
IF
    NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@OldRoomKey)), N'') IS NULL
    OR NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@NewRoomKey)), N'') IS NULL
    OR LEN(@OldRoomKey) > 255
    OR LEN(@NewRoomKey) > 255
    OR @OldRoomKey = @NewRoomKey
BEGIN
    SELECT
        @RequestId AS RequestId,
        @OldRoomKey AS OldRoomKey,
        @NewRoomKey AS NewRoomKey,
        CAST(0 AS BIT) AS InputValid,

        0 AS SourceMatchCount,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS SourceProfileListingId,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS SourceProfileListingKey,

        0 AS TargetMatchCount,
        CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS TargetProfileListingId,
        CAST(NULL AS NVARCHAR(255)) AS TargetProfileListingKey,

        N'Room keys are empty, identical, or longer than 255 characters'
            AS LookupComment;

    RETURN;
END;


;WITH Matches AS
(
    SELECT DISTINCT
        contacts.RoomKey,
        listings.ProfileListingId,
        listings.ProfileListingKey
    FROM ProfileListings AS listings
    INNER JOIN ProfileRoomLinks AS contacts
        ON listings.ProfileListingId = contacts.ProfileListingId
    WHERE contacts.RoomKey IN
    (
        @OldRoomKey,
        @NewRoomKey
    )
),
Summary AS
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN RoomKey = @OldRoomKey
            THEN ProfileListingId
        END) AS SourceMatchCount,

        MAX(CASE
            WHEN RoomKey = @OldRoomKey
            THEN ProfileListingId
        END) AS SourceProfileListingId,

        MAX(CASE
            WHEN RoomKey = @OldRoomKey
            THEN ProfileListingKey
        END) AS SourceProfileListingKey,

        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN RoomKey = @NewRoomKey
            THEN ProfileListingId
        END) AS TargetMatchCount,

        MAX(CASE
            WHEN RoomKey = @NewRoomKey
            THEN ProfileListingId
        END) AS TargetProfileListingId,

        MAX(CASE
            WHEN RoomKey = @NewRoomKey
            THEN ProfileListingKey
        END) AS TargetProfileListingKey
    FROM Matches
)
SELECT
    @RequestId AS RequestId,
    @OldRoomKey AS OldRoomKey,
    @NewRoomKey AS NewRoomKey,
    CAST(1 AS BIT) AS InputValid,

    SourceMatchCount,
    SourceProfileListingId,
    SourceProfileListingKey,

    TargetMatchCount,
    TargetProfileListingId,
    TargetProfileListingKey,

    CASE
        WHEN SourceMatchCount = 0
            THEN N'Source room was not found'

        WHEN SourceMatchCount > 1
            THEN N'Source room returned multiple entity listings'

        WHEN TargetMatchCount = 0
            THEN N'Destination room was not found'

        WHEN TargetMatchCount > 1
            THEN N'Destination room returned multiple entity listings'

        WHEN SourceProfileListingKey IS NULL
            THEN N'Source ProfileListingKey is missing'

        WHEN TargetProfileListingKey IS NULL
            THEN N'Destination ProfileListingKey is missing'

        WHEN SourceMatchCount = 1
             AND TargetMatchCount = 1
            THEN N'Entity listings resolved'

        ELSE N'Entity listing validation failed'
    END AS LookupComment
FROM Summary;

values.fieldValue: Entity listings resolved; ready to copy reviews

DECLARE @RequestId NVARCHAR(100) =
    N'{{ String($json.RequestId ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}';

DECLARE @SourceProfileListingId BIGINT =
    TRY_CONVERT(
        BIGINT,
        N'{{ String($json.SourceProfileListingId ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
    );

DECLARE @TargetProfileListingId BIGINT =
    TRY_CONVERT(
        BIGINT,
        N'{{ String($json.TargetProfileListingId ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}'
    );

DECLARE @SourceProfileListingKey NVARCHAR(255) =
    N'{{ String($json.SourceProfileListingKey ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}';

DECLARE @TargetProfileListingKey NVARCHAR(255) =
    N'{{ String($json.TargetProfileListingKey ?? "").trim().replaceAll("'", "''") }}';


IF
    @SourceProfileListingId IS NULL
    OR @TargetProfileListingId IS NULL
    OR @SourceProfileListingId = @TargetProfileListingId
BEGIN
    SELECT
        @RequestId AS RequestId,
        @SourceProfileListingId AS SourceProfileListingId,
        @SourceProfileListingKey AS SourceProfileListingKey,
        @TargetProfileListingId AS TargetProfileListingId,
        @TargetProfileListingKey AS TargetProfileListingKey,

        CAST(0 AS BIT) AS RatingInputValid,
        0 AS SourceRatingRecordCount,
        0 AS SourceRatingCount,
        0 AS DestinationRatingCountBefore,
        0 AS DestinationRatingCount,
        CAST(0 AS BIT) AS RatingsSafeToInsert,

        N'Invalid or identical ProfileListing IDs'
            AS RatingsCheckComment;

    RETURN;
END;


;WITH SourceRating AS
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS SourceRatingRecordCount,
        COALESCE(MAX(RatingCount), 0)
            AS SourceRatingCount
    FROM ProfileRatings
    WHERE ProfileListingId = @SourceProfileListingId
),
DestinationRating AS
(
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS DestinationRatingCountBefore,
        COALESCE(MAX(RatingCount), 0)
            AS DestinationRatingCount
    FROM ProfileRatings
    WHERE ProfileListingId = @TargetProfileListingId
)
SELECT
    @RequestId AS RequestId,
    @SourceProfileListingId AS SourceProfileListingId,
    @SourceProfileListingKey AS SourceProfileListingKey,
    @TargetProfileListingId AS TargetProfileListingId,
    @TargetProfileListingKey AS TargetProfileListingKey,

    CAST(1 AS BIT) AS RatingInputValid,

    source.SourceRatingRecordCount,
    source.SourceRatingCount,

    destination.DestinationRatingCountBefore,
    destination.DestinationRatingCount,

    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN source.SourceRatingRecordCount = 1
             AND destination.DestinationRatingCountBefore = 0
             AND destination.DestinationRatingCount
                    <= source.SourceRatingCount
            THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END
        AS BIT
    ) AS RatingsSafeToInsert,

    CASE
        WHEN source.SourceRatingRecordCount = 0
            THEN N'Source room has no rating record'

        WHEN source.SourceRatingRecordCount > 1
            THEN N'Source room has duplicate rating records'

        WHEN destination.DestinationRatingCount
             > source.SourceRatingCount
            THEN N'Blocked: destination RatingCount is greater than source'

        WHEN destination.DestinationRatingCountBefore > 0
            THEN N'Blocked: destination already has a rating record'

        ELSE N'Rating safety checks passed'
    END AS RatingsCheckComment

FROM SourceRating AS source
CROSS JOIN DestinationRating AS destination;

parameters.content:
## 1. Intake & Approval
Read the queue and accept only approved, unprocessed requests.

## 2. Queue & Entity Resolution
Claim the request and resolve source and destination records safely.

## 3. Review Migration
Copy reviews through the authenticated service and persist the checkpoint.

## 4. Rating Safety & Insert
Block unsafe cases, insert transactionally, and save a durable checkpoint.

## 5. Verification & Search Sync
Verify exactly one rating record, notify the search pipeline, and finalize.

## Retry Lane
Resume from the last durable checkpoint without restarting completed work.

## Blocked / Manual Review
Unsafe or failed requests stop here with an actionable status and comment.
